changelog:
Smart TV Buying Consultant v1.0.0

- Initial release offering expert, brand-neutral Smart TV buying advice.
- Engages users with targeted questions about room setup, lighting, viewing habits, content sources, connectivity needs, and region.
- Provides structured, unbiased specifications (screen size, panel type, resolution, refresh rate, HDR, audio, ports, smart OS).
- Adapts consultation to the user’s situation and technical comfort level.
- Aims to empower users to independently evaluate and choose the right Smart TV for their needs.
summary: Guide users buying a smart TV through screen size, room lighting, panel type, resolution, and usage questions to determine the exact specs they need — region...
